The product (apps/**, packages/**, migrations, deploy/**, ADRs) and the round-1 and round-2 repairs were written by the implementer roles listed. The candidate's acceptance suites under tests/qa/** and e2e/** were written before the freeze by earlier qa-verifier authoring tasks (T-DG6-QA-A to H); they were authoring tasks, not this gate review, and I judged them like any other test.
